typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MEDICAID_ID as string,
		MAINTENANCE_TYPE_CODE as string,
		MAINTENANCE_REASON_CODE as string,
		FTE_ELIGIBILITY_START_DATE as timestamp,
		TAPE_DATE as timestamp,
		FTE_ELIGIBILITY_END_DATE as timestamp,
		IMPORT_DATE as timestamp,
		FTE_APPLICATION_ID as string,
		BATCH_ID as integer,
		ENROLL_ROW_ID as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::gv_Query_Select_Refund_Rec',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of BATCH_ID} = toDouble(BATCH_ID),
		{Copy of ENROLL_ROW_ID} = toDouble(ENROLL_ROW_ID),
		{Copy of IMPORT_DATE} = toString(IMPORT_DATE)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of BATCH_ID} as double,
		{Copy of IMPORT_DATE} as string,
		{Copy of ENROLL_ROW_ID} as double,
		{} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		{Copy of BATCH_ID},
		{Copy of IMPORT_DATE},
		{Copy of ENROLL_ROW_ID},
		{})) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
